existing_capability_and_gap: Reuse existing Core private server::dispatch grant/principal/task/location/attribution/launch-intent checks in TaskRegistry so Native can call them without constructing a legacy Host or second PTY owner. No new scheduler, PTY, authority platform or persistent object/schema.
behavior: prepare_member_dispatch preserves check ordering, strict target-member principal, live grant, finished-task/cwd/known-worktree checks, immutable attribution and per-task/member request-key replay checks. It authenticates NO caller and is NOT a cached grant lease or launch confirmation. Ingress must bind identity/pause and call at effect time. Existing Host keeps its effect/pause fences and backend spawn/confirm/exit; LaunchSpec keeps the same captured configuration: the refactored caller reads that canonical Execution, not a fresh mutable member-binding query. The old local binding already represented that snapshot; this preserves it, not a claim that old code had a config-reread bug.
